newsitem.title: UK: John Lewis UK store sales +5.1% in week to Dec 21.
newsitem.headline: John Lewis UK store sales +5.1% in week to Dec 21.

text.p: The John Lewis Partnership said its UK department store sales rose 5.1 percent in the week to December 21 compared with the same week a year earlier and rose 8.8 percent in the week to December 28.
In the 21 weeks to December 21, sales were up 11.6 percent year-on-year. In the 22 weeks to December 28, sales rose 11.5 percent.

Total sales, including the Waitrose supermarket chain, fell 2.5 percent in the week to December 21 but were up 9.4 percent in the 21-week period. In the week to December 28, total sales rose 23.5 pct and were up 10.0 percent in the 22-week period.
